summary.root_cause_text: The database is read-only (SQLite 'attempt to write a readonly database'), so POST /orders fails with 500 and ledger sync fails. The cause of the read-only state is unknown.
recommended: A human should check the DB file and volume permissions, disk-full state, and read-only filesystem remount, and restore write access.
After that, run check_invariants and confirm the ledger sync catches up.
Do not roll back v1.3 or restart the worker, because neither addresses a read-only DB.
